found.no_ifc_view_today: No Studio screen shows IFC counts or structure today; the batch tray shows family and format only (apps/studio/src/features/intake/IntakeTray.tsx).
found.summary_reachable: Reachable without an API change: GET /api/v1/cases/{caseId} (already read by the batch page) lists jobs with sourceId and operation; the latest 'ifc-native' job of the item's source gives the jobId for GET .../sources/{sourceId}/ifc/jobs/{jobId}, whose result.summary carries structure.
found.batch_ifc_not_read: A .ifc dropped in a batch is kept through /uploads (retain-batch.ts viaUpload) and is never queued for the native IFC reader, which reads only sources retained through POST .../ifc (profile ifc-native-v1). So a batch IFC has no ifc-native job: the view says so in words. Routing the batch IFC to the IFC reader is a retain/server seam outside this task's view paths (and AU2 G01 wants one door); reported, not changed.
